text:
I read every file in the repo. It's a small Eleventy site with 4 content pages, a thanks page, a layout, `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml`. I haven't built the site or run it. ## Critical 1. **Canonical URLs point at a staging domain.** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` hardcodes `https://staging.brightside-dental.example{{ page.url }}`. Every page tells search engines and AI crawlers that the staging host is the canonical version. That conflicts with the production host `www.brightside-dental.example` used in `src/sitemap.xml:3-6`, `src/robots.txt:3` and `geo.config.json:1`. Read the origin from one shared source instead, such as `src/_data/site.json`, and use `https://www.brightside-dental.example`. 2. **The Services page is noindexed but is listed in the sitemap.** `src/services.njk:5` sets `noindex: true`, and `src/sitemap.xml:4` lists `/services/`. This is probably a leftover from development. Services is your main commercial page, so remove `noindex: true` at line 5. If the noindex is intentional, remove the sitemap entry instead. 3. **The structured data on the Contact page is invalid JSON.** `src/contact.njk:10` has a trailing comma after `"telephone": "0113 496 0000",`. Parsers will reject the whole block, so you currently have no schema. Fix the comma, and also add: - `url` - `address` as a `PostalAddress`: 12 Park Row, Leeds, plus postcode - `openingHoursSpecification` - `image` - `sameAs` - `geo` The `telephone` value should be in international format (`+44 113 496 0000`). ## High 4. **The Team page has no meta description.** `src/team.njk:2-4` has a title but no `description`, so `base.njk:7` renders an empty `content=""`. Add one. Make the layout omit the tag when the value is empty, or fall back to a default. 5. **The content is too thin to be cited by AI search.** - `src/team.njk:6` says "decades of experience" but names no dentists. Add each person's name, GDC registration number, qualifications and role, with `Person` schema. - `src/services.njk:8-9` is a bare list of four items. Give each treatment its own section or page with what it involves, duration, who it suits and a price range. Line 9 says "Our prices are simple and clear" but shows no prices. - `src/index.njk:7` says "Trusted by thousands of local patients", which can't be verified. Back it with real figures, reviews or ratings, or remove it. - Add an FAQ section with `FAQPage` markup. Questions like "How much does an emergency dentist cost in Leeds?" are what people ask AI assistants. 6. **There is no schema on the homepage or the other pages.** Only the Contact page has JSON-LD (`src/contact.njk:9-11`), and it's broken. Move the `Dentist` / `LocalBusiness` block into `base.njk` so it appears on every page. Add `MedicalProcedure` or `Service` markup for the treatments, and `BreadcrumbList`. ## Medium 7. **The image is probably broken.** `src/index.njk:8` references `/img/reception.jpg`. No image is in the repo, and `.eleventy.js:1` only passes through `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml`. Add `config.addPassthroughCopy('src/img')`, commit the image, and give the `` `width` and `height`. 8. **The layout is missing basic tags** in `src/_includes/base.njk`: - Line 2 needs ``. - Open Graph and Twitter tags are missing: `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:url`, `og:image`, `og:type`. - Add `` so snippets can be used in results and AI answers. - Line 9 only emits a robots meta when `noindex` is set, which is fine. 9. **`data-nosnippet` hides the insurance terms.** `src/contact.njk:8` stops search and AI systems quoting that sentence, and it's information patients want. Remove the attribute unless you really need it, and put the terms on the Services page. 10. **The sitemap is hand-written and has no `lastmod`.** `src/sitemap.xml:3-6` is a static file copied through at `.eleventy.js:1`. It will drift as pages are added or noindexed, which already happened with Services (item 2). Generate it from the Eleventy collections as `sitemap.njk` with `lastmod`, and exclude noindex pages automatically. ## Low 11. **`robots.txt` is permissive but doesn't mention AI crawlers.** `src/robots.txt:1-2` allows everything, which matches `aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"` in `geo.config.json:1`. That's fine. If you want it explicit, add `User-agent` blocks for `GPTBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot` and `Google-Extended`. Also consider a `/llms.txt` summarising the practice, services and contact details. Adoption is uneven, so this is optional. 12. **Titles and descriptions are generic.** - Titles like "Contact" (`contact.njk:3`) and "Thanks" become "Contact | Brightside Dental" in `base.njk:6`. Include the place and intent, for example "Contact Brightside Dental – Dentist in Park Row, Leeds". - The homepage title is "Family dentist in Leeds" and is fine. - Check that every description is under about 160 characters. 13. **There's no `
`, `
` or visible NAP block in the layout.** `base.njk:12-13` has only a nav and main. Add a footer with name, address, phone and opening hours on every page. It reinforces local-search signals and gives AI systems consistent facts. If you want, I can make the fixes for items 1–4, 7 and 8. They're mechanical and don't depend on real business details like dentist names or prices.
